hooks.text: While Smyrna burned, foreign warships stood by and refused the refugees.
Neutral warships watched Smyrna burn while refusing to rescue the survivors.
Why did foreign warships watch Smyrna burn without helping the refugees?

title: Why Did Warships Watch Smyrna Burn? 🤯
description: In September 1922, the Great Fire of Smyrna destroyed the city's Christian quarters while foreign warships anchored in the harbor maintained strict neutrality.
